notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
Updates and improvements


Performance optimization for multiple rooms within procedurally generated levels
Optimization of several visual effects, muzzle flashes, smoke and teleporter
Menus have been improved to work better with both lower and higher aspect ratios
Several helping tips have been added to the audio-, keybindings- and graphics-menu

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Changelist

Raised and normalized ID-EGO's voice
Fixed a bug that caused crouch to be hidden in the keymap settings
Small visual improvements to the video-settings menu

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
The team have worked hard to improve upon the game with the help of your feedback! We have chatted with you guys and watched your awesome videos and used that as reference to make the game better! We hope you will enjoy the improvements and added features.

Improvements and changes

Deeper steam integration bringing achievements and proper overlay functionality
Added full controller support with rebindable keys
Difficulty tweaks, easy and normal are now easier by making the player more resistant while making the enemies less resistant. Some of the extra respawning enemies only appear during hard and insane difficulties.
Player sprinting gives the player the ability to sprint for a short distance, after expending their Player maneuverability was slightly improved, making the player a bit thinner, allowing them to pass through more narrow areas.
Death scene, we have added a short ragdoll/cinematic scene upon player death instead of cutting directly to the “retry-menu”.
Muzzle-flash improvements, ballistic weapons saw a rework of their visual effects for muzzle flashes.
Subtitles was changed to a more readable font.
Added a toggle setting for sniper scope inside keybindings, allowing the player to choose whether to toggle the sniper scope or hold to aim.
Field of view slider (FOV-slider) was expanded to values of 80 to 120 degrees, to allow better experiences playing on different screen aspect ratios.
Optimized and made the lighting more atmospheric and vivid on several levels.
Added a text to the “tip text field” during loading screens that indicates when a procedural level is being precalculated, previously it flashed several tips as the map was recalculating.


Bugfixes

 Fixed a few graphic settings that was not working properly.
 Fixed a bug that defaulted field of view to a value of 70 degrees upon hitting “apply changes” in graphics menu without changing the field of view slider.
 Fixed a few inconsistent post-process settings


best regards!
rosmic games dev team

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Coming Soon
notes.content:
Upcoming patch 1.1.0 is currently in beta-testing, this means that it's almost done! Achievements (which is a big part of the patch) will begin showing up on steam but can as of yet not be achieved without acces to the beta.

The patch is rather big and includes a lot of new features, the biggest being achievements and controller support. A full changelist will be available on the date of update release.

Our beta process will be short and mostly internal. If we dont run into anything major we expect the update to be released during the upcoming week!

Best regards!
rosmic dev team

notes.title: BETA-3.5.0
notes.content:
This will be the final beta-patch of ID-EGO! We are confident that we have captured all major nasty bugs and bugs that had any impact on a normal playthrough. The team have been relentless and spent many a sleepless nights in bugtesting, any final adjustments before release will be part of our release version. We will still continue to release fixes and improvements as necessary after release but we are confident and very excited about the current stage of the game!

Fixes and improvements:


Slight tweaks to planet level layout to allow large enemies to pass through narrow areas and slight tweaks to render distance of different sized assets.
Slight tweaks to the final level and blocking access to earlier parts of the level when using the teleporter to travel to the later parts of the map as it does not play well backwards.

notes.title: ID-EGO-3.4.10
notes.content:
Fixes and improvements:


An area which was under water was not covered by the water physics and post process volumes
Slight tweaks to a sniper tower to grant the enemies better line of sight
Slight loadingscreen tweak for boss level to allow map longer to load
ID-EGO should now move a bit smoother in the lobby
Openable crates in the crane-puzzle now have their hatches highlighted when player is inside range to open them, as well as sounds for opening and dropping items
Tweaks to forcefield deactivation widgets to make them a bit easier to click, as well as causing them to notify nearby enemies while ticking down
Added some visual effects to last level to accompany the environment
ID-EGO logo now plays instead of placeholder text at the end-game credits
Fixed a bug which caused one or more movement keys to be locked after a loadingscreen

notes.title: BETA-3.4.9
notes.content:
Bug fixes & Improvements

Objective at turret boss updated weirdly
Turret boss debris now fades gracefully
Auto uncrouch have a little higher tolerance
Removed several spots where the player could get stuck
Enemies that should respawn did not respawn
Slight tweak to en enemy character mesh
Allowed enemy impact sounds to have higher priority in the sound concurrency stream as they not played often enough due to other sounds overriding them
ID-EGO will not be affected by explosions in the last fight which caused him to move into wrong position
Corrected a misspelled objective
Enemy ragdolls have a shorter lifetime to improve performance
Planet level got a few tweaks for sniper line of sight reasons

notes.title: BETA-3.4.8
notes.content:
Bug fixes


Optimization unintentionally removed some characters from the last last part of the final level, only occured while playing through at least one loading screen.


Improvements


Enemy projectiles now have effect and sound when missing the player and hitting environment
Energy and raygun now have a sound effect when projectile move past the player, humming and  emulating a doppler effect
Energy rifle projectile now has a sound effect on impact (both player and enemy)
Machinegun now have a more pronounced animation when running and aiming

notes.title: BETA-3.4.7
notes.content:
Bugfixes

Player could damage themselves with energy rifle under certain conditions
Objectives was faultily overwritten in changed areas on last level
Enemies sometimes did not spawn in lobby
One objective did not update properly if player quit the game at a small time interval leaving them stuck when loading the save

notes.title: BETA-3.4.6
notes.content: Fixed a bug in the last level which could cause an event not to initiate and reduced the countdown timer for another event.

notes.title: BETA-3.4.4
notes.content:
This is a minor patch fixing some issues with simulated physics assets, we have added physics substepping which allows physics assets to more accurately be simulated even with lower frames. This should minimize the chance of ragdolls and grenades passing through the environment (walls, floors, roofs etc.).

Also changed the scale of some teleportation VFX's.

Added activation/deactivation sound to flashlight.

notes.title: BETA-3.4.3
notes.content:
This is a slightly bigger bugfixing and performance optimizing patch. The biggest changes are that we added another spawn-point in the last level which comes with a new loading-screen as well, it interrupts gameplay a bit but at a safe location and for a great cause. Better FPS! This means that the last level is now 5 parts instead of 4 and that all players who had completed the last level is now set back one step in their save (sorry!).

Vortex 1 (the planet) is now visible from the lobby!

Objectives that could interrupt the next objective if the player was to quick cant do that anymore as they are cancelled.

Lightmaps that were to low resolution for some large props have been increased.

Last level have gotten a huge performance improvement-round, partially with a new loading-screen but also with some clever level-streaming.

Respawning enemies can only respawn when they are inside a valid streaming-level that is relevant to the player.

The Lobby had a few lighting-improvements for visual reasons.

Melee-weapon (energy-knuckles) got a tweak so that you can begin attack quicker after blocking.

Ambience got a big rework, adding more dynamic and living sounds to the environment, especially nice for those who prefer low or no music.

Fixed a bug where respawnpoint could decrease the players total progress in certain areas.

The explosive-barrel debris now fade away gracefully.

Fixed a bug that caused the music to be interrupted when to many sound cues played at once.
